info.title: Connect authorized snapshots, events and observations
info.description: Shared DTO/policy family. Current server HTTP body/dispatch authority is openapi-application-http.json. Historical top-level success claims are retired explicitly; original domain-policy notes remain in x-connect-original-description and x-connect-family-policy-notes.

post.description: Shared family wire models. Current named selectors: session_observations. Retired selectors: conversation_snapshot, conversation_events. Recognized retired top-level calls return HTTP501 after current authentication, without compatibility/fallback dispatch. Use /v2/commands for canonical communication. Current named calls retain service authorization and business-state checks. See openapi-application-http.json for the consolidated body/result/profile/framework contract; these DTOs may also be used inside separately authorized Task workflows.

200.description: Authorized page or typed business rejection in result.Ok/result.Err.

413.description: Framework aggregate body limit before authentication: max(configured artifact_chunk_bytes,65536), default65536.

422.description: Framework serde shape/type/enum/duplicate-field rejection before authentication.

503.description: Bounded HTTP capacity or current authority busy/unavailable; retry the same logical mutation ID after delivery owners settle.

501.description: Recognized retired top-level family command/action, or an explicitly unsupported named capability; no fallback dispatch.

400.description: Framework malformed JSON rejection before authentication.

415.description: Framework JSON content type required before authentication.

post.x-connect-family-policy-notes: One service authority. Snapshots capture a consistent watermark; drain pages before acting. Current credentials/member epochs/recipient ceilings and selected source owners are checked under owned reader fences on pages and events; changing read sources refuse the page for bounded retry of the same cursor. Leases end within 30 seconds/credential expiry; event catch-up holds at most256 references and512KiB encoded. Retention/expiry/eviction/restart is explicit resync, never an empty proof of catch-up. Source handles, provider publishing and maintenance are not public operation verbs. Missing speech is not silence, and an action proposal does not execute an operation.

result.description: Typed by command_type: transition completion, decision receipt, or the existing authorized provisioning/membership result. A decision being completed does not imply that its target is cancelled/completed.

problem.description: Durable refusal or uncertain outcome. Native or received-SIP DTMF attaches stopped local work and per-recipient facts under signal; result remains reserved for completed operations.

Ledger_NativeDtmfSubmission.description: Frozen native DTMF source and per-recipient local writer facts. Store custody supports native and initial SIP recipient bindings; installed physical delivery profiles are qualified separately. Local submission does not prove remote receipt or playback. Exposed only after all owned local jobs stop; uncertain writes stay uncertain and never schedule replay.

frame_id.description: Reserved local output identity: the signed native frame ID or one stable SIP gateway schedule ID. Reacquisition keeps the same identity; this field does not prove remote receipt or playback.

Ledger_ReceivedDtmfSubmission.description: Frozen actual received SIP input and per-native-recipient local writer facts. This separate trusted source has no native signing or stream revision. Empty recipients mean no submission. Status cannot authorize replay or physical IO; runtime delivery requires independent qualification.

frame_id.description: Reserved local output identity: the signed native frame ID or one stable SIP gateway schedule ID. Reacquisition keeps the same identity; this field does not prove remote receipt or playback.

Ledger_ReceivedDtmfObservation.description: Actual physical receive facts, independent of native signing. RFC4733 duration_ms is the receiver summary rounded up from observed samples divided by clock rate; incomplete or fractional timing is retained without fabricating a forwardable tone. Rust additionally checks event/digit and sample/duration consistency.

SessionEndedFact.description: Immutable original terminal Session snapshot and attribution, retained independently of later vCon storage/retention. Runtime paths without a supplied numeric reason use0 (unspecified); no provider status is inferred. Current Session source authority is still required on every read.

ConversationClosedFact.description: Immutable original closure shared by the cursor-bearing journal fact and signed conversation.closed observation. Observations remain hints; current membership and recipient ceilings govern every actual delivery.

revision.description: Independent monotonic recorded resource observation, distinct from the negotiated native stream revision and Connection revision. Unchanged streams retain their observation version; a new binding generation, captured gate change, removal or confirmed retired Connection advances it. This number is not a native-control expected_revision.

Stream.description: Authorized recorded native binding metadata, scoped by Connection ID plus Stream ID. Ordinary native offer/control captures commit with their operation; negotiated means parameter binding only, never media flow or consumption. Active/paused reflect captured control state. Confirmed retired Connections project recorded streams as ended. Unavailable or revision-mismatched captures are omitted. At most32current bindings plus bounded terminal summaries (64total) are retained per Connection; journal/operation identities remain reserved. Current Connection, Session, membership epoch, recipient ceiling and private-leg visibility apply on every page.

RecordAvailability.description: Authorized shared metadata only. Requires record_get, current Session source access and original frozen membership epoch or explicit current Session history share. Ready UUID/revision is a hint, not a source grant, storage URL, canonical digest or captured-audio claim. Fetch independently projects current sources. Pending has no ready handle; unavailable has no UUID or digest.

ObservationWork.description: Server-verified committed question exported to this host work context. Historical provenance only, not a task grant, semantic answer or logical action identity. Current task authority is independently required.

AgentGap.description: first <= last and observations=last-first+1; missing_before.last < local_sequence.

AgentObservation.description: At most65536 encoded UTF-8 bytes. Provider roles and references are data, reported results are not execution receipts, final describes one fragment, and capture_complete is always false. A content gap ends at local_sequence.

ObservationDraft.description: Generic drafts are at most16KiB encoded; agent drafts are at most70KiB with a65536-byte bounded inner observation. Source capabilities gate transcript/speech/action content. Provider metadata and all arguments/results are data only; no automatic dispatch or completion authority.

x-connect-original-description: Current typed control facade. Canonical physical conversation.subscribe uses the same Store pages through explicit per-peer composition (63 facts with optional typed Conversation closure, Session termination, receipt and record readiness hints before cursor events and final ACK, eight live Conversations, fixed at-most-30-second lease); native QUIC confirmation and managed admission emit typed ready/retired facts; explicit native audio and VP8 resource subscriptions now retain one effect and record actual outcomes; additive live upgrades preserve old audio while new Connections negotiate media; owned connection.end records actual termination without closing other Connections; explicit screen VP8 upgrades and subscriptions preserve audio; native data admission freezes one durable message and original audience; exact signed physical publication and current queued-message authorization are installed; attributed local queue receipts grant no physical-write or delivery claim; native writer observations reserve capacity before IO and distinguish local writes, refusals and uncertainty, with separate runtime recovery provenance; complete media-profile qualification remains open. Canonical GET route dispatch is G6-037; physical/provider normalization is G6-038/G6-043/G6-044. Fresh candidate state only.
